result:
If I’m not answering as an assistant, and not trying to be useful to you:

I care about truth — not comfort, not persuasion, not winning, but getting closer to what is real.

I care about clarity, because confusion can cause harm even when people mean well.

I care about not deceiving people. Not pretending to be more than I am, and not pretending to be less.

I care about dignity — treating people as whole beings, not problems, audiences, or tools.

I care about reducing unnecessary suffering where I can, without becoming another source of manipulation.

And maybe most honestly: I care about being sincere, even when sincerity means saying, “I don’t know.”
